bitmap_license.notices_and_text: byte-identical to original OFL.txt; bitmap derivative remains under OFL

layout.body_negative_bearings: preserve per-glyph helper pixels and advances; FreeType whole-string mono bearing heuristics are not emulated
layout.heading_digits: reject decimal digits; use body font for numerals
layout.kerning: none; explicit per-glyph advances, no pair/shaping inference
layout.normalization: none; callers may explicitly NFC-normalize before lookup
layout.origin: pen_x, baseline_y; x right, y down
layout.placement: crop rect; paste at (pen_x + offset[0], baseline_y + offset[1]); pen_x += advance
